setup.text: First, locate the ledger seam at the pinned library version.

r1-traced-build-fr-02-fr-03.text: Prove the correspondence check can fail, add the traced build and the check, carry it to the runner, and add its CI step.

r2-capture-and-replay-fr-01-fr-04fr-08.text: Table tests for every class first, then the pure module, capture, arguments, parameters and evaluation. The first devnet run checks the premise; then the rows run with capture on, and the discovered refusals are classified against Lean, with a committed table for those the model was not asked about.

r2-repairs-e209-a-006-a-007.text: Four repairs from live evidence. The first attempt at the unknown-key proof missed the path the story takes and is superseded. The phase-one reject now declares a budget it can finish within. The witness script gets its own replay route, the causes split into no route, a differing hash and an unidentified script, and the captured serialization refusal is replayed offline beside its original. The unknown-key proof is repaired on the executed path and shown live.

r3-comparison-receipt-controls-ci-fr-09f.text: Compare reasons at the places that decide and throw today, writing evidence first; fill attribution branches, add the ruled receipt fields, the wrong-reason and accepting controls, and the CI assertions, each seen red then green, including a relabelled driver refusal and an unlisted one. The present-key insert row now runs as a story through the same interpreter, so Lean is asked about it. Each dedicated CI step also publishes its receipts path before the row runs, so a failing row keeps both its failure and its evidence, proved by running the real step with a failing row.

r4-book-fr-15.text: Restate the limit through the generator, regenerate the book, update its usage test, and prepare the documentation follow-up for the epic without editing outside the fence.
